```python
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader

loader = GriffeLoader()

# Load the package at v1.0.0
old_version = loader.load("mypkg", git_ref="v1.0.0")

# Load the package at HEAD
new_version = loader.load("mypkg", git_ref="HEAD")

# Iterate over breakages and print each one
for breakage in old_version.get_breaking_changes(new_version):
    print(breakage)
```
